headline: AI dividend didn't reach them, housing prices spiral first! South Korean youth's anger heads straight for the Blue House - Finance
summary: Rising Seoul housing prices are creating higher barriers to home purchases for young South Koreans, turning the real estate issue into public discontent with the Lee Jae-myung government. The AI boom has benefited the semiconductor sector.
why: Housing affordability and household debt are key macroeconomic and political variables in South Korea, a major exporter of memory chips.
